response.sql: WITH category_totals AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) AS total FROM budget WHERE amount > 75 GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total FROM category_totals) SELECT category, average_remaining, total, total - average_total AS above_average FROM category_totals CROSS JOIN overall WHERE total > average_total;

assumptions.assumption: A budget line passes the cutoff when amount is greater than 75.
A line contributes to the total only when both amount and spent are present.

alternatives.interpretation: Sum nonmissing amounts and nonmissing spent values separately, then subtract those sums.
